summary:
The page renders normally under the new component library and all program checks pass.

No change needed: the new `FigureCompare` component is for a 2×2 set of color-vision simulation views (原界面 + 三种色觉模拟). This report's data (`data.json`) has no such simulation content — it only contains chain screenshots (`chains[].steps[].image`), which per G2 correctly use `FigureStrip`. The page was already using library components throughout, with no hand-rolled substitutes to replace.

Page structure (unchanged): 页头 → 背景信息(KV)→ 结论(Text)→ 核心指标(4 个 Stat 一行排满)→ 流程对比(整体 / 分环节两张 DataTable)→ 链路明细(协作宝、链工各一条 FigureStrip + 每步备注)→ 问题(DataTable,严重列标红)→ 下一步(3 列 List)。
